_comment: Sole source for every duration and control-point number the theme-engine emits (D-05). Every consumer resolves a semantic name — never a copied/inlined literal. The 'motion-' prefix on emitted Hyprland curve names is a deliberate collision guard against animations.conf's 12 hand-authored beziers (D-04: additive only, nothing rewired this phase).
_comment_x_easings: D-11's pre-authorized non-MD3 extension lives in .easings under the 'x-' prefix (x-overshoot, x-overshoot-in, x-undershoot-out, x-smooth-in, x-smooth-out). These are NOT MD3 — every MD3 bezier control point is inside [0,1] (13-RESEARCH.md State of the Art) — and no default token references any of them. They are single-sourced here as (a) the temporary A/B toggle's 'legacy' curve_sets set and (b) the sole sanctioned landing spot for a future D-22 retune per D-12's one-way MD3-purity policy. Deleted in plan 13-07 unless a D-22 retune permanently adopts one. Kept as plain 4-number bezier entries (not a nested comment) so the WR-02 unconditional `.easings | to_entries[]` emit loop and the malformed-control-point validator both keep treating every `.easings` entry uniformly.
_comment_curve_sets: D-21's temporary A/B comparison toggle, defined below in .curve_sets. Removed in plan 13-07 — not a permanent API. 'md3' is the default curve_sets (D-09/D-12 pure-MD3 default); 'legacy' maps the six feel-changing slots onto the pre-retrofit x-* character curves for soak comparison only, never as a reversion path. Kept as a top-level comment (not nested inside .curve_sets) so every .curve_sets key is uniformly a real set consumed by lib/motion.sh and motion-switch.sh's closed-set validation.
